value.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: To show what's playing in the notch and work its buttons, Koi asks Music or Spotify. It asks Notes, Mail, Pages or System Events only when you ask Koi to use them.
value.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: To show your AirPods' battery in the notch when they connect. It stays on your Mac.
value.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Once you connect Apple Calendar, your events show in Koi's calendar, and a change you make there goes back to Calendar. In a call, Koi reads that day's events to answer what's on your calendar, and our server keeps none of it.
value.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Dictation turns your speech into text on your Mac, and it stays there. In a call with Koi, your voice goes to the AI so it can answer.
value.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Once you connect Apple Reminders, your reminders with a date show in Koi's calendar, to tick off and change there. In a call, Koi reads what's due to answer, and our server keeps none of it.
